intended_object: The set of integral points of the fundamental cone of a number field K: the intersection of the fundamental cone (a fundamental domain for the unit action on the mixed space ℝ^{r₁} × ℂ^{r₂}) with the image of 𝓞 K under the mixed embedding. Inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses the set.
explanation: The body is literally `fundamentalCone K ∩ integerLattice K`, exactly as the docstring states. This is the standard set of lattice points in the fundamental domain, used to count principal ideals (and later ideals of bounded norm) in the proof of the analytic class number formula. The lemmas that follow confirm the intended behaviour: membership means lying in the cone and being the image of an algebraic integer; that integer is unique; the points are nonzero; every nonzero point can be moved into the set by a unit; and the torsion units act on the set. The construction is intrinsic to number fields, so it is not too narrow.
